rows.reconciliation: 2 of 3 rows close on prior_year_levy_limit,increase_2_5pct,estimated_new_growth,debt_exclusion=taxes_total; ATTESTED, the town’s own arithmetic: p53 FY24 Budgeted: the DOCUMENT is out by -55,184.33 -- the four components print 28,043,722.60 + 701,093.07 + 200,000.00 + 2,477,704.00 = 31,422,519.67 and the total prints 31,477,704.00. FY22 and FY23 foot to the cent on the same page, so the reading is sound and the report is not. Read 28 September 2026.
rows.proof: The levy build-up the Finance Committee prints: four components and the total, for three years. FY22 and FY23 foot to the cent. FY24 does NOT -- the four components sum to 31,422,519.67 against a printed 31,477,704.00, short by 55,184.33 -- and that is the town’s own arithmetic, not a misread. Our figures are exactly what the page prints; the other two columns footing to the cent is what shows the reading is sound.
